description: This file defines an interface RoleWritePlatformService that specifies methods for creating, updating, deleting, enabling, disabling roles, and updating role permissions within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: RoleWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for role management operations such as creating, updating, deleting, enabling, and disabling roles, along with updating role permissions.

methods.name: createRole
methods.description: Creates a new role based on the provided command.

methods.name: updateRole
methods.description: Updates an existing role identified by roleId with data from the command.

methods.name: updateRolePermissions
methods.description: Updates the permissions associated with a specified role.

methods.name: deleteRole
methods.description: Deletes the role specified by roleId.

methods.name: disableRole
methods.description: Disables the role specified by roleId.

methods.name: enableRole
methods.description: Enables the role specified by roleId.
